name: night hag
lore:
From the stinking mires of the Lower Planes arises the night hag, a creature of nightmare and corruption. They are the embodiment of wickedness, their very presence a blight upon the world. With skin the color of a fading bruise and eyes that burn with malevolent fire, they traffic in souls and revel in the suffering of mortals. Beware the whispers in the night, for the night hags are always listening, always scheming.

These hags are masters of dream manipulation, invading the minds of their victims to plant seeds of madness and despair. They ride upon the backs of sleepers, twisting their dreams into horrific visions, until their prey is driven to the brink of madness. When the victim finally succumbs, their soul is harvested and dragged down to the Lower Planes, where it is twisted into a larva, a currency of evil.

Dealing with a night hag is always a perilous gamble, as they are cunning and treacherous, always seeking to exploit any weakness or vulnerability. Yet, they are also creatures of immense knowledge and power, holding secrets that mortals crave. The wise approach them with caution, offering bribes of information and arcane power, for the night hags value knowledge almost as much as they value souls.
